title: Odyssey | Modern 2BR Family Retreat Near Downtown
description:
Whether you're headed downtown for live music and nightlife or staying in to unwind by the pool, The Odyssey 402 offers comfort, convenience, and a true Nashville experience. 
Located across from Centennial Park and The Parthenon! Tito’s Restaurant onsite.

The space
Explore the many things that Nashville has to offer by staying at Bourbon and Blues. When walking into this unit you will be invited into a home away from home that is professionally decorated with a modern feel and touches of Music City throughout. This 2-bedroom ,2-bathroom unit has plenty of space to accommodate the needs of couples, families, and bachelor/bachelorette groups. This unit is conveniently located near Downtown Nashville, but if you plan to stay in you have access to resort-style amenities: outdoor pool, on-site restaurant, gym, and private parking! A real gym located across the street from the Parthenon and Centennial Park. Walkable to Vanderbilt University.

All guests are required to review and sign a renter’s agreement prior to check-in. We strongly recommend purchasing travel insurance to protect your reservation against unexpected changes or emergencies.

The Odyssey is a smoke-free facility. If smoking is detected in any room or on the balcony, a $250 cleaning fee will be applied to your account.

Thank you for your cooperation!
